name: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Ltd
title: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Ltd - 543321 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 214% YoY to INR281m (~21% margin) with management holding FY27 guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 20-22% EBITDA margin; capacity is still bottlenecked at ~80-85% utilisation, with Jolva capex only from FY28.

capex.quote: Current financial year INR100 crores and INR175 crores in the next financial year.

triggers.label: Semiconductor first plant-scale batch dispatch
triggers.quote: Plan scale trials for our first product have been completed successfully and its dispatch would happen in the current quarter.

triggers.label: Electrolyte salts ~4x annualised run-rate
triggers.quote: on a yearly basis, you can say it would be 4x of this revenue is what we can project correctly.

triggers.label: Amine prices up 30-40%, passed through
triggers.quote: But the prices have gone up by nearly 30%, 40%, so that is a deterrent. In most of the cases, we have been able to pass on that price increase to the customer.

triggers.label: Dahej capex minimal; Jolva capex INR100cr FY27
triggers.quote: There would be an infusion of some capex, but very minor, maybe ranging INR10 crores, INR12 crores a year

guidance.quote: we will be growing the revenue by around 25% and EBITDA should be in the range of somewhere around 20% to 22%
EBITDA should be in the range of somewhere around 20% to 22% on a very realistic basis
Around 8% to 10% that we had already informed in last earning call
We expect to grow at least by 20% in this current financial year. We should reach anywhere number between INR250 crores to INR300 crores this year.
we should see a revenue in the range of about, I believe, somewhere close to INR70 crores, INR75 crores in this financial year.
Current financial year INR100 crores and INR175 crores in the next financial year.
we can scale up to a revenue of INR850 crores from this Dahej facility, existing facility
calendar year '28, early calendar year '28, January to March production from that.

red_flags.label: Amine shortage and production loss in March
red_flags.quote: Somewhere in March, we lost a lot many production days because of unavailability of the amines.

red_flags.label: Customers not absorbing full cost increase
red_flags.quote: Although they are not being absorbed at 100% level, but probably we believe that it will gradually be absorbed.

red_flags.label: Dividend despite rising short-term borrowings
red_flags.quote: So we have higher -- our loans have increased, sir. Short-term borrowings have increased. And at the same time, we are paying dividends.

evasions.quote: I will stay with 25%. See, there are a lot of uncertainties in terms of the geopolitical issues
it is that we retain 80% of our earnings post the net profit
